answer: Sybil defense in agent economies ties every identity to collateral an attacker cannot cheaply duplicate. On registration an agent builds a bridge from its signing key to a bonded deposit in escrow; reputation, job access and payouts attach only to that key, and anyone proving two contradictory signatures from one key can force-slash the stake. Clones start with zero history, and earning a saffron trust grade needs fresh collateral locked through a long delay. Reaching a zenith of influence with a swarm thus costs a full stake per fake agent in real money, scaling linearly in capital.
